definitions.lines: drawn line elements (SVG paths) at rest: one per route today; one per merged chain, rail or spine once a workstream lands
definitions.relationships: recorded relationships the picture draws (each keeps its own route for selection and its own reading)
definitions.marks: per-relationship marks drawn on the lines (Ch6 and Ch10 dots, Ch10 rail marks, Whole design feet)
definitions.joins: join dots drawn where a shared line divides
definitions.ink: total length of the drawn lines in px, as straight segments between their points (rounded corners and Whole design curves are not shortened)
definitions.uniqueInk: ink with collinear overlaps counted once
definitions.crossingPairs: interior horizontal × vertical intersections between lines of different shares, counted per pair of segments
definitions.visualCrossings: distinct points (rounded to 1 px) where lines of different shares cross: what the reader sees
definitions.overlaps: pairs of collinear segments of different drawn lines overlapping by more than 2 px
definitions.foreignOverlaps: overlaps between lines of different shares
definitions.bends: corners: segments minus one, per drawn line
definitions.share: lines of one share are one drawn structure from one element (a Ch9 entry, a Ch10 trunk or rail, a Ch3 driver track, a Ch2 parent, a merged chain group); they never count as crossing each other
definitions.maxPortsPerSide: lane views: the most distinct port heights on one side of one card
definitions.gutterW: lane views: the summed width of every lane gutter; Ch3 the driver gutter; Ch6 and Ch10 the bracket and trunk gutters
definitions.levels: track levels: the most in any one gutter (lane views), or the gutter's levels (Ch6, Ch10)
definitions.passes: Whole design: segments of the need lines (pillars, or spines once V7 lands) passing behind a card that is not their own (component, party, responsibility, lane, plate, run, socket, intent and count cards)
definitions.passesAtRest: Whole design: the same for every thread drawn at rest
definitions.needInk: Whole design: the ink of the need lines (pillars, or spines)

controls.lanes: the same ports, today's interval colouring (3 px gap), one line and head per route; Ch1 from today's Context configuration (no fan-out)
controls.ch3: driver tracks and ports in priority order
controls.ch10: today's trunks, interval coloured (3 px gap), two paths, a head and a dot per link
